programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: How the UN Is Turning SDG Priorities Into Investable Capital: Partnerships for Economic Transformation | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: Sustainable development needs more than ambition. It needs investment. At UNGA81, the European Union, Government of Spain and Uruguay and the UN Joint SDG Fund are convening a bold conversation about turning national SDG priorities into deals investors want to make.

programme.title: Social Business, Youth and Technology
programme.desc: The 2026 gathering will be the 11th edition of this UNGA High-Level Side Event. The programme will bring together leaders, practitioners, innovators, and young people to advance practical, global south-led solutions; promote human-centred technological innovation; and strengthen cross-sector partnerships. It will further examine how scalable social business models can advance a World of Three Zeros—a vision of zero poverty, zero unemployment, and zero net carbon emissions—and translate global commitments into measurable action.

programme.title: (Day 1) SDG Media Zone – 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
programme.desc: Join the United Nations Department of Global Communications live broadcast during UNGA81 from 21-25 September. Discover the transformations, innovations, and global solutions required to accelerate progress on the Sustainable Development Goals.

programme.title: Daily Press Briefing by the Spokesperson of the Secretary-General
Women and Girls in Afghanistan: 5 years of Resistance, Solidarity and the search for Accountability | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: Five years on from the Taliban takeover, Afghanistan faces a dire humanitarian, socio-economic and human rights crisis. Women and girls are living under unparalleled restrictions brought about through more than 200 laws and decrees, denying over 2.6 million girls access to secondary education and removing women and girls from public life.

programme.title: Tackling Organized Fraud: A Way Forward from the Global Fraud Summit
programme.desc: This high-level event aims to sustain global momentum following the Summit and support the translation of political commitments into concrete progress. It provides an opportunity to amplify the Call to Action and the Global PPP Framework, engaging Member States and stakeholders in shaping a coherent, collective response to organized fraud. The event will contribute to efforts to protect populations in the digital age and advance innovation through strengthened public-private cooperation. It will foster open dialogue and reinforce international collaboration among States, the private sector, and civil society to transform commitments into real-world impact.

programme.title: Least Developed Countries Green Industrialization Facilitation (LDC-GIF) Mechanism
Unlocking Climate Innovation: From Global Commitments to Local Green Technology Deployment
programme.desc: A high-level dialogue on accelerating green technology deployment through innovation, partnerships and South-South cooperation, connecting climate commitments with practical solutions that support sustainable development and resilience.

programme.title: Heat, Cities and Early Warnings: Acting on El Niño, Preparing for the Future | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) confirmed on 3 July 2026 that El Niño conditions had developed. Combined with long-term climate change, El Niño is expected to increase the likelihood of higher temperatures and more frequent and intense heat events in many regions over the coming months.

programme.desc: The UN LGBTI Core Group will hold a high-level event during the 81st session of the General Assembly under the theme “Championing Diversity in Times of Adversity: Standing Up for LGBTI Persons”, bringing together States, the United Nations, civil society and voices from business, sports and the arts to showcase how they have continued to stand up for LGBTI persons in complex national, regional and global dynamics.

programme.title: Launch of COP31 Action Agenda From Ambition to Implementation: Introducing the COP31 Action Agenda
programme.desc: The event organized by COP31 Presidency of Türkiye will focus on introducing the COP31 Action Agenda’s strategic vision, priority areas and implementation approach to an international audience, while mobilising political support, partnerships and stakeholder engagement towards COP31 and beyond.

programme.title: Women, Peace, Justice and National Reconciliation in Afghanistan
87 Million Lives: Delivering on the Promise
programme.desc: The Ministerial-level flagship event will be cohosted by the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the European Union and OCHA. It will take stock of what has been achieved towards the objective of mobilizing US$23 billion to reach the 87 million people facing the most severe and life-threatening humanitarian needs within the broader response set out in the 2026 Global Humanitarian Overview, which targets 135 million people worldwide.

programme.title: (Opening remarks only) Partnership for Multilateralism Summit
programme.desc: The “Partners for Multilateralism Summit”, co-hosted by António Costa, president of the European Council, William Ruto, president of Kenya, and Mark Carney, prime minister of Canada, will bring together a diverse group of countries from different regions that share a commitment to strengthening multilateralism, upholding international law, promoting peace, and advancing sustainable and inclusive prosperity. Its aim is to foster a debate on how to coordinate efforts to promote a rules-based multipolar order and to rebuild trust in global governance together with other like-minded partners.

programme.desc: The discussion will consolidate a strategic bi-regional alliance between Europe and LAC, leveraging and aligning Europe’s Global Gateway Investment Agenda with regional development finance institutions and private-sector leadership. It will advance public-private investment agenda focused on reducing risk, expand bankable pipelines and connecting capital with transformational projects that generate development impact.

programme.title: (Day 1) General Debate - General Assembly: Plenary meeting, 81st session
programme.desc: The debate of the 81st session opens on Tuesday, 22 September, continues through Saturday, 26 September, and concludes on Monday, 28 September 2026. World leaders discuss global issues.

programme.title: (Day 2) SDG Media Zone – 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
programme.desc: Join the United Nations Department of Global Communications live broadcast during UNGA81 from 21-25 September. Discover the transformations, innovations, and global solutions required to accelerate progress on the Sustainable Development Goals.

programme.title: Fourth CAF–UNDP Conference on Governance for Development "Democratic Institutions for the Future: Governing Complexity and Renewing Trust"
programme.desc: The Fourth CAF–UNDP Conference on Governance for Development will bring together Heads of State, subnational authorities, development partners, and leading academic voices to advance a regional institutional innovation agenda that strengthens the capacity of Latin American and Caribbean democracies to build trust, anticipate risks, and deliver development results while safeguarding people’s rights and freedoms.

programme.title: The Digital Public Ecosystem: Identity, Trust, and Inclusive Access in the Digital Economy
Oceans - Solutions Dialogues, Climate Summit 2026
programme.desc: The Solutions Dialogue on Ocean Action and Leadership at the Climate Summit 2026 is being convened by the UN Secretary-General’s Special Envoy for the Ocean and the Secretary General’s Climate Action Team.

programme.title: Voices that Move: In Conversation with Liza Soberano & Pritika Swarup | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: In an era where social media and public platforms amplify voices like never before, influence carries both opportunity and responsibility. For many public figures, a platform begins as a space to share their work, creativity and personal journeys. Over time, it can evolve into a powerful tool for advocacy, representation and social impact.

programme.title: (Opening) COP31-IEA High-Level Energy Transition Dialogue
programme.desc: Opening segment of the COP31-IEA High-Level Energy Transition dialogue focusing on the actions needed to increase the share of electricity in global final energy consumption to 35% by 2035, as a means of reducing emissions while also advancing energy security, affordability and economic growth.

programme.title: From Knowledge to Prevention: The UN Action Approach to Addressing Conflict-Related Sexual Violence

programme.title: Two Years After the Pact for the Future: Progress on Implementation, Challenges and Opportunities for Africa
Global Food Security and the Black Sea – the need for restoring freedom of navigation
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of intensifying attacks affecting Black Sea grain exports, the event will discuss the global consequences for food security, with a particular focus on the need for diplomatic action to ensure the continued flow of food and grain exports to global markets. The event will seek to build political support and reinforce the global call for a moratorium on attacks in the Black Sea against infrastructure and shipping.

programme.title: Pathfinders: Global Leadership in uncertain times | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: This high-level conversation will explore how global leaders are interpreting today's rapidly evolving landscape, the implications for the international system, and the choices that will shape the years ahead. Looking beyond immediate crises, the discussion will reflect on the future of cooperation, the resilience of global institutions, and what will be required to foster stability, prosperity, and trust in a more complex and interdependent world.

programme.title: Twelfth Ministerial Meeting of the Friends of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT)
programme.desc: The 12th Ministerial Meeting of the Friends of Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT) celebrates the 30th anniversary of the opening for signature of the Treaty through the theme, “The CTBT at 30: Reflecting on Progress, Shaping the Future”. The CTBT Friends are Australia, Canada, Finland, Germany, Japan and the Netherlands. The Meeting will be co-chaired by Australia and Japan, and moderated by the Foreign Minister of Australia, Senator the Hon Penny Wong.

programme.title: Financing Adaptation in the Era of Overshoot - Solutions Dialogues, Climate Summit 2026
programme.desc: The Solutions Dialogue on Financing Adaptation in the Era of Overshoot at the Climate Summit 2026 is being convened by the UN Secretary-General’s Climate Action Team.

programme.title: From Promise to Progress: The Next Breakthroughs for a Changing World | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: The UN Secretary-General's SDG Advocates occupy a unique place at the intersection of business, public life, culture, philanthropy, and grassroots leadership, bringing together perspectives that span sectors, communities, and geographies.

programme.title: Childhood in Custody: High-Level Dialogue on Palestinian Children in Military Detention
programme.desc: Organized by: Save the Children International, The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, Ireland, State of Palestine

programme.title: Beyond 2030: Renewing the Global Commitment to End Poverty in All its Dimensions
programme.desc: There is an urgent need not only to accelerate progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), but also to begin reflecting on how the international community can renew and strengthen its commitment to poverty eradication in the decades ahead. Poverty must remain at the centre of global development efforts beyond 2030.

programme.title: Protecting Children’s Rights facing artificial intelligence: the Coalition for children’s rights and protection in the age of Artificial intelligence as an Operational Too
programme.desc: On the margins of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, the Leaders of France, Spain, Kenya and Australia will convene Heads of State and Government and global leaders for a high-level dialogue to advance practical cooperation to protect the rights of children and their safety in the digital age.

programme.title: G77 and Emerging Partners Ministerial Roundtable Addressing Technology-Facilitated Violence Against Women and Girls
programme.desc: Technology facilitated violence against women and girls (TF VAWG)—including online harassment, non-consensual intimate image abuse, doxing, cyberstalking and AI enabled abuse— continues to increase in scale, reach and severity as digital technologies rapidly evolve, with profound impacts on women and girls’ safety, education, participation in public life, access to justice and economic empowerment.

programme.title: Financing for Women's, Children's, and Adolescents' Health in a Time of Austerity
programme.desc: The Global Leaders Network for Women’s, Children’s and Adolescents Health (GLN) is convening a high-level meeting on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly to sustain political momentum for women's, children's, and adolescents' health (WCAH) at a moment of unprecedented financing pressure.

programme.title: Two Regions, One Future: Financing Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response to Build Global Health Security
programme.desc: As world leaders gather during the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly and the High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response (PPPR), this side event will highlight the urgent need for sustained investment in pandemic prevention, preparedness and response as a cornerstone of global health security, economic resilience, and sustainable development.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving! Thanks to their tolerance of human visitors, manatees have mates everywhere, working tirelessly to ensure they roam the world for generations to come.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, even the rarest – some of the most iconic creatures in the natural world. Many are familiar but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers. The cubs will have to trust their instincts, their mother and the power of the pride if they are to make it to adulthood and take their place on the African plains.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: On the African plains lions rule. They're not the biggest or fastest animals around, but stealth, teamwork and the strength of the pride means they almost always come out on top.

programme.title: Brown Bears Teddy Bears Picnic
programme.desc: If you go down to the woods today a wonderful treat awaits! The home of one of the planet's most loved and characterful animals – the brown bear. Baby bears have a lot to learn about life in the forest, but thankfully all bears know their way around a good picnic.

programme.title: Wild Gangs
programme.desc: Life can be tough at times, but it gets much easier when you have friends to watch your back. Animals from across the natural world band together for all sorts of reasons. Whether it's to protect the home and family, to find food, win a mate or even go to war, it's always handy to have someone you can trust in your corner. From the classic pack of wolves stalking prey in tandem to the bullish lionfish mobs terrorising all other fish on the reef – when animals form gangs things soon get wild!
